sloka: हविष्पन्दो मधुष्यन्दो दृढनेत्रो महारथः ।पूर्णे वर्ष सहस्रे तु ब्रह्मा लोक पितामहः ॥१-५७-४॥
transliteration: haviṣpando madhuṣyando dṛḍhanetro mahārathaḥ ।pūrṇe varṣa sahasre tu brahmā loka pitāmahaḥ ॥1-57-4॥

translations.english: When an adorable sage like Vasishta has already said, it is not possible, how can we help you conduct such a sacrifice?
